annotations.title: Generate a 3D model with AI (text or image → STL/GLB/OBJ)

description: Turn a text prompt or an image into a print-ready 3D mesh (STL/GLB/OBJ geometry) with PrintPal's AI generator. Without a PrintPal API key this returns a link that opens the generator on printpal.io with the prompt prefilled; nothing is generated until the user clicks it. With an API key header (`Authorization: Bearer pp_live_…`) it submits the job to the user's own account, spends that account's credits, and returns a `generation_uid` that `check_3d_generation` accepts. Suited to organic/sculptural objects (figurines, animals, props); exact-dimension mechanical parts are handled by `design_parametric_cad`.

image_url.description: Optional public PNG/JPEG/WebP URL for image-to-3D (API-key mode only).

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. "low-poly fox figurine, sitting".

quality.description: default/high/ultra for text or image; super*/superplus* tiers are image-only high-res.
